query: sum_over_time(((sum by (node) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="",id!="/"}[5m]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left(node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info)) / sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"})) > bool 0.9)[7d:5m]) * 5
why: Minutes the node CPU usage exceeded 90% of allocatable (7d, 5-minute samples). At 0 a noisy neighbour had no room to do real harm
